semantics: What the periodic table and Element Hub do, what is a gap and what needs a human. Coverage dimensions stay separate (see the other five reports).

featureFlag.name: periodicTableV1
featureFlag.offBehaviour: the /periodic routes render the existing “page not found” and the search has no element entries — the learner app is unchanged

routes.unknownSymbol: a plain notice on the table page

search.system: the existing learner search (src/features/search/model.ts) — no second search
search.flagged: elements join the index only with periodicTableV1

checks: every cell a link with a full accessible name
profile heading focused on open; Escape closes; focus returns to the cell
no colour-only semantics (filters list matches as text; no category colour)
320 px: cells wrap in Z order, 48 px targets, no page scroll
accessibility.learnerInvariant: 140 / 5 / 0 / 1 (the sweep covers learning activities; the periodic page is tested by its own suite)

bundle.note: the Element Hub is a pack file loaded only on /periodic and on a flagged search

isolation.contentStudio: no element editor; the Studio is unchanged
isolation.learnerProgress: none: no profile, no attempt, no evidence written
isolation.otherFeatures: curriculum, practice, dynamic lab, textbook excerpt and Content Studio do not import the periodic feature

notInScope: authoring metadata or names (human, sourced, reviewed)

humanDecisions.decision: sources for relative atomic mass, category, oxidation states and teaching descriptions
review of the 20 localized element names and names for the remaining 98
electron configurations of Z 24, 29 and beyond Z 36

formalMetrics.note: the periodic table is reference infrastructure; no formula input changed
